title: Majorization between symplectic spectra of positive semidefinite matrices
summary: Given $2n \times 2n$ real symmetric positive semidefinite matrix $A$ with symplectic kernel, there exists a real $2n \times 2n$ \emph{symplectic matrix} $M$ such that $M^TAM= D \oplus D$, where $D$ is an $n \times n$ non-negative diagonal matrix which is unique up to permutation of its diagonal entries. The diagonal entries of $D$ are called the \emph{symplectic eigenvalues} or symplectic spectrum of $A$.
